sampled_bombus_context.reading: Observed network-sampling context only. Zero Bombus rows mean no Bombus taxon was recorded in the archived pollinator species x site x season network table for that subset; this is not a biological absence assertion outside the sampled networks.

mechanistic_gain: FDQ remains positively associated with corrected trait matching in all eight sites, in the five Izu island sites alone, and even within the four post-Oshima islands. The post-boundary association therefore does not require mainland observations or the Oshima bridge-state site. Leave-one-island coefficients remain positive throughout both island subsets, so no single island is required for the direction.
relation_to_binary_boundary: Within Niijima, Kozu, Miyake and Hachijo, FDQ still explains positive trait-matching variation after site and season fixed effects. The archived pollinator table contains zero observed Bombus species x site x season rows in this post-Oshima subset. Continuous pollinator functional structure therefore contains explanatory variation inside sampled post-boundary networks and should not be reduced to a binary observed-Bombus label.
claim_boundary: Observational contemporary association only. Site fixed effects remove time-invariant site confounding and common season effects are absorbed, but time-varying weather/resources, measurement error, feedback within networks and historical selection remain. The sampled Bombus audit is not an archipelago-wide biological absence statement. The post-boundary result does not identify Bombus loss as the cause; it shows that continuous pollinator functional diversity contains explanatory variation beyond the binary sampled-network contrast.
